title: Free Night Awards Stay Eligibility Matrix
content:
The Free Night Awards stay eligibility matrix sets, for each award type, the rooms, occupancy, seasons, brands, booking channels, advance timing and booking forms on which an award night may be booked.

## Matrix

| Term | 25K | 35K | 40K | 50K | 85K | Any Hotel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Room types the award may pay | Standard King; Standard Two Queens | Standard King; Standard Two Queens | Standard King; Standard Two Queens | Standard King; Standard Two Queens | Standard King; Standard Two Queens | Standard King; Standard Two Queens |
| Most adults in the room on an award night | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Award seasons in which the award may be used | Off-peak, standard, peak | Off-peak, standard, peak | Off-peak, standard, peak | Off-peak, standard, peak | Off-peak, standard, peak | Off-peak, standard, peak |
| Hotel brands where the award may not be used | Ashbury Reserve | Ashbury Reserve | Ashbury Reserve | Ashbury Reserve | Ashbury Reserve | None |
| Channels through which an award night can be booked | Brand website, mobile app, call centre | Brand website, mobile app, call centre | Brand website, mobile app, call centre | Brand website, mobile app, call centre | Brand website, mobile app, call centre | Brand website, mobile app, call centre |
| Minimum calendar days between applying the award and the award night | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Usable inside a group block | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Award night may be booked for a guest other than the member, on the member's reservation | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Column headings name the 25K Free Night Award, 35K Free Night Award, 40K Free Night Award, 50K Free Night Award, 85K Free Night Award and Any Hotel Free Night Award.

## Terms used in the matrix

- **Room types** are the room types recorded on the reservation; only the two standard room types listed may be paid by an award.
- **Adults** are the adults registered in the room.
- **Award season** is the award pricing season the hotel's calendar assigned to the arrival night, recorded on the reservation at booking.
- **Excluded brands** are the hotel brands, as recorded on the reservation, where the award may not be used. Every capped award type excludes Ashbury Reserve; the Any Hotel Free Night Award excludes no brand.
- **Minimum advance** of 0 calendar days means that an award may be applied as late as the day of the award night.

## Readings of the matrix (hypothetical reservations)

- A hypothetical reservation of a Standard Two Queens room with 2 adults at an Ashbury Reserve hotel meets the room and occupancy terms of the 50K Free Night Award but falls in its excluded brand; the same reservation is outside no brand exclusion of the Any Hotel Free Night Award.
- A hypothetical reservation with 3 adults registered exceeds the most adults, 2, for every award type.
